periods.name: 第二届伊·U同学会 / Reunion成立
periods.summary: Sherlock gathers former I-U, Nautilus and related allies. He explains Moriarty's seven-life contract, Carbuncle, and the hidden WATSON objective, while Kinji coins the mixed alliance name Reunion.
periods.outcome: Kinji is appointed leader of a seven-person field team: Kinji, Monkey, Hilda, Lucifelia, Eliza, Watson and Meluette.
